name: Zhongyin Babi Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongyin Babi Food Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of Chinese-style pasta and pastry products in China. It offers steamed buns, mantou, whole grain snacks, and a series of fillings products. The company also provides beverages and sticky rice dumplings. It serves catering, food supply chain, convenience store chain, restaurant chain, and retail platform customers. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Shanghai, China.
